snippet.title: A Hollow Harvest FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
A Hollow Harvest By Michaela Thisten End 2 True Ending Horror Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

You find yourself in a quiet little village. After inheriting an old farm from a deceased brother, a family reaches out for your help to find out what's responsible-but the investigation isn't easy; someone locked everything up.

A Hollow Harvest: https://michaela-thisten.itch.io/a-hollow-harvest
Developer: Michaela Thisten
Genres: Horror
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
